_comment: Single source of truth for API-key roles and the scopes they grant. Consumed by the Python API (dbcore/rbac.py enforces scopes per endpoint), the Qwik dashboard (role picker on /dashboard/settings) and the MCP server (filters which tools a key can see and call). Keep roles additive: each role is a superset of the previous one. Environment client keys (exp_env_*) are NOT API keys: they can only call the evaluation endpoints and carry no role.

scopes.projects:read: List and read projects and their environments.
scopes.projects:write: Create and update projects and environments, rotate environment keys.
scopes.flags:read: List and read flags, their per-environment states, export a project, preview evaluations.
scopes.flags:write: Create and update flags, change per-environment states, copy flags between projects.
scopes.usage:read: Monthly usage counters and plan limits.

editor.label: Editor
editor.description: Viewer, plus create and update projects and flags, toggle states, copy flags.

admin.label: Admin
admin.description: Editor, plus delete projects and flags and read the audit log.
